item.review:
The empty-input guard is right, but two paths still break on blank input.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Guard the empty slice before indexing — /work/inline/src/parser.ts:42-48
  `tokens[0]` is read before the length check, so blank input still throws.
  Move the guard above the first read.

- [P3] Typo in the error message — /work/inline/src/errors.ts:7-7
  "recieved" should be "received".
